identity: Ochre traces and warm stone; prehistoric material thought, no modern symbols or machines.
typography: One shared prominent scene heading; only meaningful integrated labels, no duplicate slogans. Bundled Red Hat Display/Text.
sourceImages: Single cover inspected, no interior diagrams or photos present in canonical source; original material silhouettes adapted to presentation rather than copying elaborate cover.
choreography: Source-appropriate gradual reveals, considered movement, stillness, and posture/scale contrasts; captions remain isolated.

cast.ar: Young hunter; library rig person-15 base, dark curls, brown skin, rust-red hide tunic (Night #d9735a). Scale .84.
cast.taan: Ar’s companion; person-16 base, short auburn hair, light skin, ochre tunic (Night #e2b54f). Scale .82.
cast.karr: Storyteller; person-20 base, bearded, salt-and-pepper bob, plum tunic (Night #a48ccd). Scale .86 (.7 when standing back across the fire).
cast.kee: Oldest member, keeper of memory; person-23 base, grey bun, deep skin, green tunic (Night #62b79f). Scale .76.
cast.lu: Child; person-17 base, no glasses, blue tunic (Night #7fa9d9). Scale .56.

dress: All cast: fur collar instead of scarf; no zipper, pocket or buttons; hide leggings #6b5140 (Night #a08a74) and dark hide shoes (Night pale).
performance: Open-eyed rigged faces with character.express per sentence, character.gesture and lookAt staggered so gaze settles before gestures; per-sentence plan in each scene visual.performance.
labels: No in-art text except the book cover title (50 stage px, ~13 CSS px at 320 px width).
